summary: Parses a track data file into a coordinate linked list. Re-inits the object's list state to empty (head/tail/insert/count fields zeroed), frees any previously-built list, opens the file with the .rt extension via sub_587DB0(a2, aRt), then reads lines until the file's +12 flag byte has bit 0x10 set. Each line is parsed for NumCoordinates then Coordinate via sub_565760; matching lines allocate a 12-byte coordinate record and a 12-byte list node (data at +0, next at +4, owned flag at +8), appended after the tail. Finishes by closing the file with FileCloseWithLock.

Re-init the list state to empty: this[85] count, this[89] head, this[90] tail, this[91] insert pointer and this[92] node count are all zeroed.
When the file handle v10 is non-null and the file's flag byte at +12 has bit 0x10 clear, proceed into the line-parse loop; otherwise skip parsing.

When both parses succeed (v11 > 0 and the Coordinate parse returns non-zero), build a list node: allocate 12 bytes via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(12), store the coordinate record pointer at node+0, next = 0 at node+4, and owned flag = 1 at node+8.

Append node to the list: when the head this[0x164] (this[89]) already exists write the new node into the tail's +4 next slot, otherwise set head = insert = new node; then advance tail this[0x168] (this[90]) and node count this[0x170] (this[92]) and increment the coordinate count this[0x154] (this[85]).
On the parse path, close the file with FileCloseWithLock (callee 0x00587D02) and return its result; when no file was opened the function returns the null handle.
